answer_1.quote: multimodal abstractive summarization (MAS) aims to generate a concise textual summary

answer_2.quote: we use the standard ROUGE scores (R-1, R-2, and R-L)

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate the performances of mT5, VG-mT5 and our SOV-MAS, we conduct human studies on 50 samples randomly selected from English and Chinese test sets. We invited three Chinese postgraduate students who are highly proficient in English comprehension to compare the generated summaries under the multilingual training setting and assess each summary from three independent perspectives: fluency (Flu.), conciseness (Conci.) and informativeness (Info.).
answer_4.guideline: assess each summary from three independent perspectives: fluency (Flu.), conciseness (Conci.) and informativeness (Info.)
